Name: SailorMoon Wands
Author: kumarisuchan
Description:
Hi everyone, this is my mod that replaces the Galaxy Sword and Lava Katana to Sailormoon wands!

For installing instructions: Paste and replace the '[b]weapons.xnb[/b]' file under [b]Contents > TileSheets [/b]
Always remember to back up your files first!

This is my first mod so feel free to leave me any suggestions if I should do more weapons like replacing the slingshots, etc.
Please do not re-upload anywhere. But you can edit them for personal use!
Also, do feel free to screenshot your game play if you do decide to use my mod, it will really make my day!

You can find me on tumblr [url=https://kumarisu-chan.tumblr.com/]here[/url]﻿ where I will post some mods progress and illustrations occasionally.
